title: Lightly Roasted Greek Lamb Gyro
description: A quick and easy Greek dish featuring roasted lamb, clear honey, and a crispy slate tile vessel, all in a convenient gyro form. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together honey, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Place the lamb shoulder in a large bowl and brush the honey mixture evenly over the lamb.
Let the lamb marinate for 10 minutes.
Place the lamb on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the lamb is cooking, toast the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for 5 minutes.
Once the lamb is cooked, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
Assemble the gyro by spreading a piece of pita bread with a few slices of lamb, some diced tomato, and a few slices of red onion.
Serve the gyro on a slate tile vessel and enjoy.
To achieve a nigiri-like shape, simply shape the lamb slices into small oval shapes before placing them on the pita bread.
